content: Antota kamanapa a-so
Tigeba to wasanama aupi pima kamana a-nkuwaitaiyo. Kampa uwaitakibepa, tigeba pabiyama antota kamanapa kampa uritakiye.
Piya, tigeba wasana antota kamana uwaitakibe, pabi nkawameta Kotiba tigeba uritakiye. Piya, wasana pabi aborawaimikibe nkawameta Kotiba a'wae puma timikiye.
Pigoya, kao'yagarama nkaobipa i'nintana waintakanapa, ayama agantana, kaeka kaobi ya atu waintakanapa, nanaga ae aogi potakenaga napiyene.
We, kaeka kaobi ya atu waintemipa, kaeba ayama kao'yagaragaba mayaba omegana aogi pikiye: Nao'yagara, kaeba abintaga, kaobi i'ni waintika maegagasanoma, aogi pikiye.
We, kumpari kina, kaeka kaobi ya atu waintemi, pipa maru maegaite aogima agantana, kao'yagarama nkaobisa i'ni maegasagana aogi pikiye.

Pigoya, tigeba monotasaenaba kara kanta kinapa a-nkimiyo. Piya, aogi mono kutatipa yaga kanta kinapa a-nkimiyo. Igeba pintanaba uwa igisarasa aewarigaitegini pabigo a'wae puma tige tiba nasanaga, piyaba a-piyo, piya untiye.
Wasanama esegi puma nunamu ukena kamanane
Pigoya, tigeba Koti abigaiginaba timikiye. Aguyosagaiginaba au'wapa maema tigeti aborakiye. Kabera aiwakarusiginaba Kotiba aititakiye.
Piya, Kotiti esota kina'miba maeyawe. Aguyosaga kina'miba agawe. Kabera aiwakaruse kina'mitiba Kotiba ai'itaye.
We, tigetisa ae ntagarama yagarawampa nanintaga yekanaba antotapa yabapa amikiye, a.
Inoyantaga yekanaba kuyaba amikiye, a. Pipa kampaye.
We, tigeba antage kina'mitaba yagara aragaripa aogiyena imewe. Piya, mantarisa tibarimpa aeba asugasima esota kina tigepa aogiyenaba tabera timikiye.
Pigoya, tigeba wasanami purataiyema tibikibintanaba, pabi nkawameta igepa puwaitaiyo. Piya puwaitamagiri, tigeba Moseseke poropete kina'mike kamana'ama nkagoba aborakibewe, piya untiye.
Kabewama kamanane
Pigoya, tigeba uwaena kabintori mantari ima uma pasiyo. Ataena pikena kuma'ama kabewapa pipa tabewe. Piya ke'wapa pabiyama tabe waiyegini, pita'iba uwoma kina'miba pasewe.
Piya, miyaba kuma'ama kabewapa uwaenanto waiyegina, ke'wapa wakenaba esegi puntiye. Pita'iba uwaena kina'antomi pasewe, piya untiye.
Kumpari poropete kinaka aogima kabiyiyo

Tigeba kumpari poropete kina'mika aogima kabiyiyo. Igeba i'amaba sipisipi kanta purite tigeti paebuma kanakibewe. We, intabaipintiba igeba kabu kara kanta puma tige tiba nakena kanakibewe. Pika aogima kabima miyiyo.
Pigoya, mono au'waipa agamagiri agowaipa aogima agakibewe. Piya, wasanami waini a'wapa akenanaenabintisa kampa asikewe. Piki yawamapa asigi'ma nakenaba agaenabintisa kampa asikewe. Kampaye.
Piya, aogi yawamaba aogi yamanka aeyagiri asikewe. We, ata yawamaba ata yamanka aeye.
Piya, aogi yawama ata yamanka aekenaenaba kampa waintegina, ata yawama aogi yamanka aekenaenaba pabiyama kampa waintiye.
Pigoya, a'ya'ma yawama aogi yamanka kampa aeyaginiba aga'yuma yakupi maebugasawe.
Pika naeba maya yuwe: Pi kina'mi mono au'waimpa igama agowaika aogima abikibewe.
Pigoya: Wa'egane, Wa'egane, sumagini nagise kina igeba a'ya'maginiba Koti kabiratakena mantariba kampa ikibewe. Kampaye. Mantarisa nabanempa nkawamu wasiye kina igemana ikibewe.

Piya, pi kanabipa uwoma kina'mi maya unamikibewe: We, Wa'egare, Wa'egare, taeba kae kawamutapa wasanaba monopa uwaiminta, ke kinapa kae kawamutapa agaruba igainta, kae kawamutapa tabena aboranema puntompene. Kampa tagantano, ukibewe.
Piya unamigipa, naeba maya uwaimukuwe: Naeba ayantaga tigabebe puntone, a. Aguntaena pe kina tigeba ae'wama wawaegasiyo, piya uwaimukuwema, untiye.
Esegima aema mikena kamanane
Pigoya, wasana ka'waina ma kamana'ne abima wasikibipa, aeba napi napi yagara ae awametane. Pi ntagara aeba namankapa u takaitasa nama kintiye.
Kimaraogana waintogana, tabe ka aema wani pa'ma iguguya pumagina akasabakena pugagate ataogana waintantiye. Piya, esegi yarasa kimaraomeka tonkiya puma waintantiye.
Pigoya, wasana ka'waina ma kamana'ne abima kampa wasikibi, aeba aibo yagara ae awametane. Piya, aibo yagara ka'waina aeba namanka amunta yarasa kintiye.
Kimaraogana, tabe ka aema wani pa'ma iguguya pumagina kana namapa akasakasu pa'wantiye, piya untiye.
Pigoya, Isu ma kamana uma a'ya ataogini abimagini pami puntawe.
Piya, aeba mono tisa kina'mi yesa kamana nane. Aeba kiye kina'mi yesa puma uwaimintiyema, untawe.
